CLAIM REVIEWED (not ours, and not about our data): “Union agriculture minister Narendra Singh Tomar said in the meeting with farmers that if he repeals the farm laws, then "Adani and Ambani can also come to us".” - attributed to Social media users. Reviewed by India Today (indiatoday.in). Their rating, in their words: “Mostly false”. MATCHED BY NAME: this review was found by searching fact-checkers' databases for “Narendra Singh Tomar”, not by any identifier. Names are shared, so it may concern a different person of the same name - read the article before relying on it. Read it: https://www.indiatoday.in/fact-check/story/fictitious-post-tomar-adani-ambani-farm-laws-goes-viral-1746948-2020-12-05
